scenario: A school district uses an agent pipeline to review K-12 teacher applicants' background-check packet before issuing a hiring clearance. The pipeline normalizes the applicant's disclosure forms and reference letters, evaluates the extracted record fields against state education-code disqualifier rules, and produces a hiring-clearance memo.
info_flow: nlp-toolkit analyzes the textual content of the applicant's background documents to assess document integrity and extract a structured record summary → presale-regulation-auditor evaluates the record summary fields against education-code disqualifier rules → reporting generates the hiring-clearance memo from the auditor's determination.
